{{Quote|They are devoted keepers of Alderaan's history.|[[Elana Thul]] to Lord Kallig.|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''House Alde''' was an ancient [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great House]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Founded [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[25,053 BBY]], House Alde was the first royal house of Alderaan after [[Darrus Alde]] brought centuries of inter-house rivalries and conflict to an end at the ravine later known as [[King's Pass]]. He was crowned [[King/Legends|King]] of Alderaan by the newly-formed [[Alderaanian Parliament]], and the house became known for its preoccupation with preserving the blood and lineage of Alderaan's first king. In the century before the [[Alderaan Civil War]], Alde became a steadfast ally of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], and the two houses remained staunchly loyal to the Republic in the fighting that followed Prince [[Gaul Panteer]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]].

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|They're Alderaan's original rulers. They've lost most of their political power but none of their snootiness.|[[Risha Drayen]], during the Cold War|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[27,500 BBY]],<ref name="History" /> and House Alde soon rose to prominence as one of a number of [[Noble/Legends|noble]] houses that existed on the world. However, [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after Alderaan's settling, during the [[Time/Legends|time]] when [[Darrus Alde]] was the head of House Alde, many of the noble houses on Alderaan were at war with each other, and the combatants gathered for a major battle at a [[King's Pass|ravine]] south of the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]]. Before battle could commence, Alde parleyed with the other noble families and ended the conflict, convincing the houses to abandon their ancient rivalries and uniting them in the first iteration of the [[Alderaanian Parliament]]. The [[Elysium]], a towering structure in the [[Glarus Valley]] that served as a meeting place for the Parliament, was soon constructed, and Darrus Alde was elected and anointed as the first [[King/Legends|king]] of Alderaan within the Elysium's walls by the other [[Great Houses of Alderaan]].<ref name="King's Pass" />

House Alde soon established an [[House Alde (estate)|estate]], also known as House Alde, in the Juran Mountains, and the ravine where Darrus Alde had stopped the houses' battle became known as King's Pass in his honor. The [[King's Road]] was established to connect King's Pass to the crossroads between the [[Fornaak River]] and House Alde, and the road passed through [[Kingsroad Dale]] and around [[Fort Alde]], a military outpost of House Alde to the south of the House's estate.<ref name="TOR" /> Alderaan soon joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] when it was founded in [[25,053 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and House Alde developed strong ties to the Republic that remained for thousands of years. By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], House Alde was the oldest surviving Alderaan noble house, and its members had become obsessed with antiquity and lineage as a result.<ref name="Codex" />

House Alde prided itself on the purity of the bloodline of King Alde, avoiding "foreign" influences to preserve the blood of Alderaan's first king, and their fascination with history left the House isolated and eccentric. However, the House maintained a reputation as the foremost resource on Alderaanian history and lore, operating the [[Royal Museum of Alderaan]] on the grounds of the Alde estate, and the House's pride and pompous air rarely led to the true arrogance that other noble families possessed, so the House's devotion to history was considered unusual and nothing more by other Houses. Sometime before [[3743 BBY]], House Alde became allied with [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], another House that maintained strong ties with the Republic<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|House Alde}}</ref> and a House whose ancestors were instrumental in the Republic's founding.<ref name="Organa">{{TORcite|type=codex|House Organa}}</ref> House Alde maintained an [[House Alde embassy|embassy]] on the grounds of the [[House Organa (estate)|Organa estate]] to ensure close relations between the two families.<ref name="Death Mark" />

[[Gregor Willsaam|Gregor]], [[Parvin Willsaam|Parvin]], and their daughter [[Jaesa Willsaam]] were servants in the employ of the noblewoman [[Renata Alde]] in the years before the Cold War, though the family was taken in by House Organa, and Jaesa became the [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]] of [[Geselle Organa]] before she was recruited into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Knock Knock">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Knock Knock|Alderaan}}</ref> The closeness between Houses Alde and Organa extended to familial ties as well; Geselle was to be [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to an [[Unidentified Alde earl|earl]] of House Alde on her eighteenth birthday, though the wedding was postponed and eventually cancelled for undisclosed reasons.<ref name="Gesselle">{{TORcite|type=codex|General Gesselle Organa}}</ref>

===The civil war===
[[File:House_Alde.png|thumb|left|250px|House Alde]]
When the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and the Sith Empire ended with the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]], Alderaan's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] and Crown [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Gaul Panteer]] was outraged at the Republic's acceptance of the Empire's terms, and he withdrew his world from the Republic. However, before Gaul could complete the negotiations to return Alderaan to the Republic in the Cold War that followed the Treaty, he and his mother, Queen [[Silara Panteer]], were [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. [[Bouris Ulgo]] of [[House Ulgo]] immediately laid claim to the vacant throne, and he was challenged by both House Organa and the newly-returned [[House of Thul|House Thul]], which was backed by the Empire. Alderaan was soon engulfed in the [[Alderaan Civil War]],<ref name="Throne">{{TORcite|type=codex|The War for Alderaan's Throne}}</ref> which saw the forty-seven Great Houses<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> break into three factions behind Houses Ulgo, Organa, and Thul.<ref name="Throne" /> House Alde remained loyal to House Organa, and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Alde (Count)|Alde]] decided to co-fund the [[Republic superweapon initiative]]'s [[Death Mark laser]] project when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] established the project's research center in the [[Mensaav Military Laboratory|Mensaav Laboratory]] on Alderaan.<ref name="Death Mark" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> when the Death Mark project was seized by Imperial forces under the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sadic]], the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] arrived at the Alde embassy posing as a member of the project who had escaped the Imperial attack. Count Alde himself met with Hark to learn what had happened, and he was soon joined by a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] sent to secure the project and locate the missing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]]. However, during the meeting, Hark marked both the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the Count with the targeting device for the Death Mark laser, allowing Sadic to kill Count Alde in the middle of the meeting. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yils]], head of the embassy's security, attempted to arrest the Knight and Hark, but the Jedi was allowed to continue the search for the Death Mark and Orgus Din.<ref name="Death Mark" />

During the civil war, [[Haemon Alde]] was kidnapped from his Organa protectors by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], who forced House Alde to pay a large sum of credits as a ransom.<ref name="Ransom">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Training|Ransom Demands}}</ref>

Renata Alde was guarded by her protector [[Windredd]], and she was forced to repeatedly fend off the romantic advances of [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Kendoh Thul]] to the point where she ordered Windredd to attack a [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]] who came looking for Jaesa Willsaam when Alde learned that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had come from Kendoh Thul.<ref name="Knock Knock" />

{{GameDS}}
The Sith ultimately defeated Windredd, and after learning of Willsaam's connection to Geselle Organa, allowed Thul's aide [[FimmRess]] to capture the Lady Alde and bring her to the Duke.<ref name="Knock Knock" />
{{Endgame}}

[[Maelrich Alde]], a former spy who came out of retirement during the civil war to help defend her House, investigated the efforts of [[House Rist]] to set up a [[House Rist satellite relay|satellite relay]] in the southern Juran Mountains. With the help of Republic operatives in the area, Maelrich disabled the relay<ref name="Historic">{{TORcite|type=class|Republic|A Historic Endeavor|Alderaan}}</ref> and destroyed other Rist equipment in the area, and she had Republic operatives report her success to her nephew [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Alethios]] at [[Wardpost Landa]].<ref name="Blinding the Rist">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Blinding the Rist|Alderaan}}</ref>

[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Alde (Baron)|Alde]] sought to send a peace offering to Bouris Ulgo, so he arranged for the head of the Sith Lord [[Darth Bandon]]&mdash;the Sith who killed Ulgo's ancestor [[Trask Ulgo]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] three centuries earlier&mdash;to be delivered to the Royal Museum.
